remarks: Looking for a little peace, privacy, and a place to call your own? This beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath ranch in the quaint town of Stafford is about to steal your heart! Nestled on 3 scenic acres, this property offers the perfect escape from the hustle and bustle while remaining conveniently located between Buffalo and Rochester. Who says you can’t have the best of both worlds?! Step Inside & Fall in Love! From the moment you walk through the door, you’ll notice the care and attention to detail throughout. The spacious living room makes a statement with its soaring vaulted ceilings and oversized front windows, filling the space with beautiful natural light. Modern updates bring a fresh, stylish feel to this country retreat, including seamless vinyl flooring, chic board-and-batten accents, contemporary paint colors, updated light fixtures, doors, and hardware. Add in the beautifully updated main bathroom and an impressive primary bedroom walk-in closet with custom organization, and you’ll quickly see why this home stands out! THREE ACRES. ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES. This is where your imagination can run wild! Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind at the end of the day on the back deck while taking in the peaceful surroundings. Dream of your own walking trails? A backyard fire pit for evenings under the stars? A pool for those warm summer days? There’s room to bring your vision to life! If you’ve been dreaming of a home that combines modern updates, meticulous maintenance, and the freedom of country living, this Stafford gem is calling your name! Come see what makes this property so special!
